list.p: When there are 2 or more Hollow Special Operations Section 6 characters in your squad: When Active Skill or Bangboo Chain Attack hit Shocked enemies, the DMG increases by 45%. When attacking enemies under other non-Electric Anomalies, attacks accumulate 100% more Anomaly Buildup.
When there are 2 or more Cunning Hares character in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases with fewer enemies in combat, up to a max of 45%.
When Remielle is in the squad: When using an Active Skill, all buffs are guaranteed, and Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by 15%.
When there is at least 1 Support character in your squad: Active Skill recovers 20% more HP. Active Skill has 3 more charges.
When there is at least 1 Anomaly character in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by 20%. When the target is a Organic enemy, this effect increases by an additional 15%.
When there is at least 1 Attack character in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by 30%.
When there are 2 or more Physical Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.

When there are 2 or more Yunkui Summit characters in your squad: Belion's DMG increases by 25%. When an Agent activates an Ultimate, the cooldown of Belion's Active Skill is reduced by 4s. Can trigger up to 2 times. Belion's Active Skill refreshes the available trigger count.

When there's at least 2 Angels of Delusion characters in your squad: When Biggest Fan uses its Active Skill, all Agents in the squad gain 50 ATK for 30s.The Attribute Anomaly Buildup dealt by Bangboo Chain Attack is increased by 15%.
When there's at least 1 Support character in your squad: Bild N. Boolok's Active Skill releases 7 Block Spikes, and its Active Skill DMG increases by 30%.

When there's at least 2 Krampus Compliance Authority characters in your squad: When an Agent uses an EX Special Attack, Birkblick's Daze inflicted increases by 4%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. At 3 stacks, DMG increases by 10%.
When there is at least 1 Pierce-type character in your squad. Bangboo Chain Attack: DMG increases by 30%.
When there's at least 1 Attack or Anomaly character in your squad: When an Active Skill is used, there is a 60% chance for that instance to deal 40% increased DMG.
When there is at least 1 Support character in your squad: Ether bubbles come into contact with characters, they generate an additional 60% Energy for off-field characters.
When there is at least 1 Attack or Anomaly character in your squad: Brawlerboo enters the Airborne state ahead of time when the battle starts. The first dive attack's DMG is increased by 120%.
When there are 2 or more Victoria Housekeeping Co. character in your squad: Active Skill generates an additional 20% Energy.
When there 2 or more Fire Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 60% more Anomaly Buildup.

When there are at least 2 Ether Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 40% more Anomaly Buildup. After activating Bangboo Chain Attack, the coordination state lasts for 5 more seconds and can activate 4 more times.
When there are at least 2 Electric Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 60% more Anomaly Buildup.
When there's at least 1 Rupture character in your squad: Upon using an Active Skill, the sword draw is guaranteed to succeed, and DMG increases by 30%.

Triggered when there is at least 1 Support-type character in your squad: Active Skill's character buff effect is increased: Buff 1: HP Recovery increases by 20%. Buff 2: Shield generated increases by 20%. Buff 3: Energy Regen increases by 0.04 points/s.
When there is at least one Support character in your squad: When characters come into contact with Knight's Stars, their ATK increases by 20 + Bangboo level × 1.2 for 10s.

list.pn: Luck is a Component of Power
list.p: When there are 2 or more Physical Attribute characters in your squad: Active Skill inflicts 20% more Anomaly Buildup. Active Skill's continuous strikes duration is increased by 0.8s.
When there is at least 1 Anomaly character in your squad: Active Skill attack range is increased, and DMG is increased by 30%.
When there's at least 2 Defense Force characters in your squad: When an Agent deals Aftershock DMG, Mercury's next Active Skill gains 22.5% increased DMG. Can stack once every 5s, up to 2 stacks.

When there is at least 2 Spook Shack character(s) in your squad: When a character touches a Spectral Bubble, HP recovered increases by 20%. When a character touches a Twinkling Star, Energy generated increases by 20%.

When there are 2 or more Criminal Investigation Special Response Team characters in your squad: After using an Active Skill, there is a 50% chance to trigger a follow-up with 1 extra hit, up to a maximum of 3 consecutive triggers. Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by 35%.
When there is at least 1 Attack or Anomaly character in your squad: Every activation of the Active Skill boosts Active Skill DMG by 25%, up to a maximum of 100%.
When there is at least 1 Defense character in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack generates Shield for all squad members based on the number of enemies hit, up to a max of 15% of Paperboo's Max HP.
When there are 2 or more Ice Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 60% more Anomaly Buildup.
When there are 2 or more Electric Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.

When there are at least 2 Sons of Calydon characters in your squad: Active Skill DMG increases by 36%. After Active Skill deals DMG to an enemy, when that enemy is defeated, the skill's cooldown is reduced by 4s.
When there are 2 or more Ether Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.

When there is at least 1 Mockingbird character in the squad: When the on-field character in the squad meets the Specialty requirements, the Active Skill fires a fixed card with a buff:Attack: Fires only Hearts, increasing the DMG by 45%.Stun: Fires only Spades, increasing the Daze buildup by 27%.Anomaly: Fires only Crowns, increasing the Anomaly Buildup by 90%.
When there are 2 or more Fire Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.
When there are 2 or more Belobog Heavy Industries characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by 20%. If the target is Burning or Shocked, this buff increases by an additional 20%.
When there are 2 or more Ice Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.
Triggered when there are 2 or more Stars of Lyra characters in the squad: When Snap applies the Superstar status to an Agent, immediately restore the Agent's Health equal to 4% of its Max HP.
When Ye Shunguang is in the squad: Sprout's DMG increases by 30%. When using its Active Skill while in Ether Veil: Verdict, 1 Sword is summoned to the field.
When there is at least 1 Stun character in your squad: Active Skill inflicts 18% more Daze to enemies whose Daze is above 50%.

When there's at least 1 Roscaelifer characters in your squad: When any squad member triggers Vortex or uses a Chain Attack, all squad members gain 2 Energy, and Ultra Jake's Active Skill deals 25% increased DMG for 45s. This effect can trigger once every 30s.
